🚨🚨🚨 GPT reanalyzes 376 previously unsolved cases and surfaces leads for 18 diagnoses

It’s not AI about replacing doctors, actually AI didn’t diagnose anyone. This is what really matters:

🔸It read phenotype data, inheritance patterns, variant tables, and the literature
🔸It connected scattered evidence into testable hypotheses
🔸Humans reviewed every one
🔸CLIA labs confirmed them

That’s the actual story: AI as a tireless research layer, with humans making every call.

posts.text:
A Netflix engineer just shipped something amazing!

It promises to cut your token usage by 60–95%.

How? It compresses everything your AI agent reads (tool outputs, logs, RAG chunks, files) before it hits the model.

100% local. Your data never leaves your machine.

Reversible, too: originals are cached and the LLM can retrieve them on demand.

Works with Claude, Cursor, Codex, Aider, Copilot as a library, a proxy, or an MCP server.

The proof that caught my attention 👉 accuracy held flat on GSM8K and TruthfulQA while compressing context.

30K stars on GitHub and growing. Apache 2.0. Worth a look.

posts.text:
🚨🚨🚨 You can run any LLM on Codex now!

Most devs think Codex is locked into OpenAI’s models.

It isn’t.

Buried in the advanced config is a quiet but powerful capability: you can point Codex at any model provider.

→ Custom providers via model_providers (base URL + wire API)
→ Run local OSS models with --oss (Ollama, LM Studio)
→ Plug in Azure, Mistral, or your own LLM proxy
→ Route through a custom openai_base_url for data residency

The agent harness and the model underneath it are now decoupled.

That’s the real shift. The interface you code in no longer dictates the intelligence behind it. You pick the brain.

More info in the comments 👇

These are 26 Claude Code shortcuts every dev using Claude Code should master.

Save the list 👇

SESSION CONTROL

/clear - Wipes context and starts clean.
/rename [name] - Renames the session.
/rewind - Rolls back to an earlier checkpoint.
/resume [session] - Reopens it by ID or name.
Leave it blank and Claude auto-generates one.
/export [filename] - Saves conversation as plain text.
/branch [name] - Forks the conversation to a new path.

MODEL & USAGE

/extra-usage - Unlocks extended usage when limits hit.
/model [model] - Switches to Sonnet, Opus, or Haiku.
/cost - Shows token usage for the current session.
/usage - Shows plan limits and rate-limit status.

/init - Builds a CLAUDE.md guide on first run.
/add-dir <path> - Adds a directory for file access.

posts.text:
“AI is just a tool.”

That’s the mistake 90% of companies make.

They treat AI like a hammer → grab it, swing it, expect results.

Most companies roll out AI top-down. The CEO pushes IT to deploy tools. Everywhere. For everything. For everyone.

Then they stare at the dashboard and wonder why nothing moved.

Because they bought the what before they understood the why.

The tool was never the hard part.

Stop asking “which AI should we use?”

Start asking “what problem are we actually solving?”

The slice you’re obsessed with is 5% of the work.

The other 95% is thinking.

What’s the “why” your team skipped? 👇
